featured.title: Can a tech titan ace a test to fix India’s crisis-hit education system?
featured.summary: India’s tech titan Nandan Nilekani faces an uphill battle overhauling the country’s education system amid exam scandals, student protests and rising youth unemployment. Nilekani, co-founder of technology behemoth Infosys, was appointed head of a national task force for exam reforms following widespread anger and controversies over alleged paper leaks involving the competitive exam for aspiring doctors, the National Eligibility Entrance Test. Analysts say the real test for a reformer best known...
featured.titleZh: 科技巨头能否通过考试改革来解决印度的教育危机？
featured.summaryZh: 印度科技巨头南丹·尼勒卡尼被任命为考试改革特别工作组负责人，以应对考试丑闻和学生抗议。他面临着解决教育系统腐败和青年失业问题的艰巨挑战。
featured.whyImportant: 印度教育系统的改革成败直接关系到该国未来的人才储备及社会稳定。

global.title: Russia says Ukrainian drone attack kills 7 at Black Sea resort beach
global.summary: Russia said on Monday that seven people, including three children, had been killed and 40 injured at its Black Sea holiday resort of Gelendzhik in what it said was a deliberate Ukrainian drone attack on civilians. There was no immediate comment from Ukraine, which like Russia, ‌says it does not deliberately target civilians in the full-scale war which Moscow launched in 2022. Social media videos, verified by Reuters, showed what appears to be a drone slamming into a busy beach area near the town...
global.titleZh: 俄罗斯称乌克兰无人机袭击导致黑海度假海滩7人死亡
global.summaryZh: 俄罗斯方面称，乌克兰无人机对黑海度假胜地格连吉克发动了蓄意袭击，造成包括三名儿童在内的7人死亡，另有40人受伤。乌克兰方面对此暂无回应，且此前一直否认在战争中蓄意针对平民。
global.whyImportant: 此次事件若属实，将标志着俄乌冲突中针对平民目标的袭击进一步升级，可能引发更严重的报复行动。

global.title: Trump declines to call for Max Miller’s resignation amid abuse allegations – as it happened
global.summary: This live blog is now closed. Sign up for the US Breaking News email On Tuesday, we’ll bring you the latest from Michigan where voters will head to the polls for competitive primaries in Senate and House races. The most closely watched competition is the Democratic primary for the US Senate, where congresswoman Haley Stevens is up against former public health official Abdul El-Sayed. They’re vying to ultimately win the seat of outgoing senator Gary Peters in November. The race has now turned into a proxy battle for the future of the Democratic party. Establishment-backed Stevens has received support from party leaders and her race has been buoyed by millions from the pro-Israel lobby. Meanwhile the insurgent El-Sayed has built a strong grassroots movement and is endorsed by progressives lawmakers in the Democratic caucus. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 特朗普拒绝在虐待指控中要求马克斯·米勒辞职
global.summaryZh: 美国密歇根州即将举行竞争激烈的初选，其中民主党参议院初选成为关注焦点。现任众议员海莉·史蒂文斯与前公共卫生官员阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德展开角逐，该选战被视为民主党未来走向的代理人战争。
global.whyImportant: 密歇根州的初选结果将反映民主党内部建制派与进步派之间的力量对比，对后续选举格局具有重要影响。

global.title: Japan’s prime minister tours earthquake-hit sites as recovery efforts hampered by soaring temperatures
global.summary: Prime minister Sanae Takaichi visited Kumamoto prefecture almost a week after a magnitude 7.1 quake hit, killing 38 people Japan’s prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, has visited the south-western prefecture of Kumamoto, where recovery efforts are being hampered by heat and a lack of water supplies, almost a week after a magnitude 7.1 earthquake killed dozens and caused widespread damage. Thirty-eight people died during the quake, including one person who died of apparent heatstroke while taking shelter in a car in hot weather, officials said on Monday. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 日本首相视察地震灾区，高温天气阻碍救援工作
global.summaryZh: 日本首相高市早苗视察了熊本县地震灾区，该地区一周前遭遇7.1级地震，已造成38人死亡。目前灾区面临高温和供水不足的严峻挑战，救援工作进展缓慢。
global.whyImportant: 极端天气叠加地震灾害对日本政府的应急响应能力提出了严峻考验，并引发了对灾民安置条件的关注。

We all feel for him and the circumstances that he went through. And for anyone to be offering illegal drugs as an inducement or for any other reason is obviously a crime. Should not be committed and people should pay a price if they’re engaging in that kind of criminal behavior. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻：圣基尔达小企鹅恐因禽流感大量死亡；腐败调查揭露5万美元“堆票”计划
global.summaryZh: 澳大利亚联邦环境部长就前橄榄球明星卢克·贝特曼关于博彩公司提供非法药物的指控作出回应。此外，圣基尔达地区的小企鹅正面临禽流感的威胁。
global.whyImportant: 博彩行业的腐败指控和生态环境危机同时引发了澳大利亚公众对社会治理和环境保护的广泛讨论。

global.title: 北陸と東北が梅雨明け 気象庁発表 熱中症対策の徹底を
global.summary: 気象庁は、4日午前、北陸と東北南部、東北北部が「梅雨明けしたとみられる」と発表しました。すべての地域で梅雨明けしたことになりますが、福岡県では39度の危険な暑さが予想されているほか、熊本地震の被災地でも猛烈な暑さが予想されています。引き続き、熱中症への対策を徹底してください。
global.titleZh: 气象厅宣布北陆和东北地区梅雨结束，呼吁严防中暑
global.summaryZh: 日本气象厅宣布北陆、东北南部及北部地区梅雨季节结束。随着全国进入盛夏，多地预计将出现极端高温，政府呼吁民众务必采取防暑措施。
global.whyImportant: 梅雨结束标志着日本进入高温高湿的夏季，防暑降温成为公共卫生领域的首要任务。

global.title: 熊本地震の復旧へ予備費支出を決定 プッシュ型の物資支援など
global.summary: 政府は今回の熊本地震の復旧を迅速に進めるとして、今年度予算の予備費から242億円余りを支出することを決めました。
global.titleZh: 政府决定从预备费中支出资金用于熊本震后恢复
global.summaryZh: 为加快熊本震后恢复工作，日本政府决定从本年度预算预备费中拨出约242亿日元。资金将用于包括“推式”物资援助在内的紧急救灾措施。
global.whyImportant: 政府迅速拨付专项资金体现了对灾后重建工作的重视，旨在缓解灾区物资匮乏的燃眉之急。

global.title: “今回の熊本地震 特に暑さ対策が重要” 現地に派遣のDMAT医師
global.summary: 今回の熊本地震で、DMAT＝災害派遣医療チームとして今月2日まで熊本県に派遣された医師が、NHKの取材に応じました。被災地では断水が続き、連日、透析患者を別の病院に移送しているなどとしたうえで、10年前の熊本地震と比べて特に「暑さ」対策が重要だと訴えました。
global.titleZh: DMAT医生：此次熊本震后防暑降温尤为重要
global.summaryZh: 一名曾被派往熊本的灾害派遣医疗团队（DMAT）医生指出，灾区断水情况持续，且需不断转移透析患者。他强调，与十年前的地震相比，此次灾区的高温天气使得防暑工作成为重中之重。
global.whyImportant: 医疗专家的建议揭示了灾后特殊环境下公共卫生管理的复杂性，对后续救灾策略具有指导意义。

global.title: 熊本地震1週間 38人死亡 災害関連死いかに防ぐかが喫緊の課題
global.summary: 熊本県で最大震度7を観測した地震から4日で1週間です。これまでに災害関連死の疑いがある人などを含めて38人が死亡しました。被災地では連日、危険な暑さが続く中、車中泊を余儀なくされる人もいて、災害関連死をいかに防ぐかが喫緊の課題となっています。
global.titleZh: 熊本震后一周死亡人数达38人，如何预防灾害相关死亡成紧迫课题
global.summaryZh: 熊本县地震发生已满一周，包括疑似灾害相关死亡在内，遇难人数已达38人。在持续的高温天气下，许多灾民被迫在车内过夜，如何防止灾害相关死亡成为当前最紧迫的课题。
global.whyImportant: 灾害相关死亡的增加凸显了灾后安置环境对脆弱人群生命健康的直接威胁。

global.title: Sportsbet and Tabcorp deny allegations they sourced drugs and sex workers to encourage VIP clients to bet more
global.summary: Betting firms respond to claims made by anti-gambling campaigners Tim Costello and Luke Bateman at parliamentary inquiry Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Betting giants Sportsbet and Tabcorp say there is no evidence to substantiate allegations that account managers sourced drugs and sex workers to incentivise vulnerable people to bet more, calling for information about the claims to be provided to regulators. The anti-gambling campaigners Tim Costello and Luke Bateman used a parliamentary hearing into Labor’s legislation to curb gambling advertising to allege problem gamblers had been supplied with cocaine, alcohol and sex workers, alleging companies exercised no duty of care to their customers. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 博彩公司否认提供毒品和性工作者以诱导VIP客户投注
global.summaryZh: 针对反博彩活动人士的指控，博彩巨头Sportsbet和Tabcorp否认其客户经理曾提供毒品和性工作者来诱导赌徒。公司呼吁将相关证据提交给监管机构进行调查。
global.whyImportant: 此争议引发了对博彩行业道德标准及监管力度的广泛质疑，可能推动相关法律法规的收紧。

global.title: Immigrant being held at Delaney Hall dies, marking 22nd death in ICE custody
global.summary: Edwin Lopez-Cornejo, 41, was arrested in New Jersey in June, and died after a ‘medical emergency’, agency said An immigrant being held at a New Jersey ICE detention center died on 1 August, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) announced on Monday. Edwin Lopez-Cornejo, 41, is the 22nd person to die in ICE custody this year, according to agency data. Lopez-Cornejo, who is originally from El Salvador and first came to the US in 2006, was arrested by ICE agents in Plainfield, New Jersey, on 18 June and sent to Delaney Hall detention facility to await deportation. Less than two months later he suffered an unspecified “medical emergency”, and was later pronounced dead by University Hospital in Newark, New Jersey, ICE said. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 一名被拘留的移民在德莱尼大厅死亡，系今年ICE拘留期间第22起死亡事件
global.summaryZh: 美国国土安全部宣布，一名41岁的萨尔瓦多籍移民在被ICE拘留期间因“医疗紧急情况”死亡。这是今年以来在ICE拘留期间发生的第22起死亡事件。
global.whyImportant: 移民拘留中心的医疗保障和人权状况再次引发了美国国内关于移民政策的激烈辩论。

china.title: 防衛白書「新しい戦い方」に対応 防衛関係の産業基盤を強化
china.summary: ことしの防衛白書はAIやドローンを活用した「新しい戦い方」に対応するため、防衛関係の生産・技術基盤を強化する重要性を強調しています。また、中国については、軍事力の質と量を急速に強化しており、日本と国際社会の深刻な懸念事項だと指摘しています。
china.titleZh: 防卫白皮书：应对“新战法”，强化防卫产业基础
china.summaryZh: 日本今年的防卫白皮书强调，为应对人工智能和无人机带来的“新战法”，必须强化防卫生产和技术基础。白皮书同时指出，中国军力的快速增长是日本及国际社会的严重关切。
china.whyImportant: 日本防卫政策的调整反映了其对地区安全环境变化的担忧，并预示着未来防卫产业投入的增加。

china.titleZh: 特朗普选举主张被驳斥，美国对关键矿产的担忧：七篇关于美中关系的文章
china.summaryZh: 本文精选了近期关于美中关系的七篇重要报道，涵盖了美国对华关税政策及关键矿产供应链等议题。这些报道反映了当前美中在经贸与战略领域的复杂互动。
china.whyImportant: 梳理美中关系的关键议题有助于理解全球地缘政治与经济格局的演变趋势。

china.title: Chinese executive filmed taking cash on Colombia metro, South America’s biggest project
china.summary: Colombian prosecutors are investigating allegations that executives of a Chinese state-owned contractor building the Bogota metro demanded cash from a local subcontractor in exchange for releasing payments owed for work on the project, according to an investigation published over the weekend by Semana, the country’s leading news magazine. The consortium building the line has denied any wrongdoing, saying the money seen changing hands was a retention payment agreed upon between the two firms in a...
china.titleZh: 中国高管在哥伦比亚地铁项目现场被拍到收取现金
china.summaryZh: 哥伦比亚检察官正在调查中国国有承包商高管涉嫌向当地分包商索贿的指控。涉事财团否认存在不当行为，称相关款项为双方约定的保留金。
china.whyImportant: 此事件可能影响中国企业在海外大型基础设施项目中的声誉及后续合作环境。

china.title: 500 Hong Kong students get taste of military life as PLA summer camp returns
china.summary: About 500 Hong Kong students are getting a taste of army life, with the PLA garrison launching its annual summer camp to instil patriotism and discipline, and teach military skills, among young people. Among the new recruits is Lo Wan-lung, a Form One student at Salesian English School who is attending the two-week camp for the first time. Attracted by the chance of weapons-related training, the young military enthusiast said he was curious to experience holding weapons during mock shooting...
china.titleZh: 解放军夏令营回归，500名香港学生体验军旅生活
china.summaryZh: 约500名香港学生参加了为期两周的解放军夏令营，旨在培养爱国情怀、纪律意识并学习军事技能。学生们对模拟射击等训练表现出浓厚兴趣。
china.whyImportant: 此类活动旨在加强香港青少年对国家及军队的认知，是香港国民教育的重要组成部分。

china.title: KMT accuses Taiwan’s government of failing to uphold South China Sea claims
china.summary: Opposition parties in Taiwan have accused the government of failing to defend the island’s long-standing claims in the South China Sea, following its muted response to Philippine attempts to delimit a disputed shoal. “The government speaks loudly when confronting mainland China, but falls silent when Japan or the Philippines challenges Taiwan’s claims,” Kuomintang culture and communications committee director Chen I-hsin said on Sunday. Chen was referring to the Philippines’ move to assert...
china.titleZh: 国民党指责台湾当局未能捍卫南海主权主张
china.summaryZh: 台湾反对党指责民进党当局在南海问题上立场软弱，未能有效应对菲律宾对争议岛礁的划界企图。国民党批评当局在面对大陆时态度强硬，但在面对日菲挑战时却保持沉默。
china.whyImportant: 南海主权争议的复杂性持续影响台湾内部政治，并考验其在区域地缘政治中的外交策略。

usa.title: US stocks near record high, oil falls as Trump claims Iran talks underway
usa.summary: Benchmark S&P500 approaches all-time peak as Washington, Tehran offer conflicting accounts of status of talks.
usa.titleZh: 美股接近历史高点，特朗普称伊朗谈判正在进行，油价下跌
usa.summaryZh: 标普500指数接近历史峰值。与此同时，华盛顿与德黑兰就谈判状态各执一词，市场对地缘政治局势的反应导致油价下跌。
usa.whyImportant: 美伊关系的波动直接影响全球能源市场及金融市场的稳定性。

usa.title: Does the US blockade on Cuba make America safer?
usa.summary: Trump just escalated restrictions on Havana warning that Cuba remains a ‘threat to national security’.
usa.titleZh: 美国对古巴的封锁是否让美国更安全？
usa.summaryZh: 特朗普升级了对哈瓦那的限制措施，警告称古巴仍是美国的“国家安全威胁”。这一政策引发了关于封锁措施有效性及必要性的讨论。
usa.whyImportant: 美国对古巴的强硬政策反映了其在西半球的地缘战略考量，但其长期效果仍存争议。

usa.title: US State Department to close consulates in Canada, Japan and Indonesia, sources say
usa.summary: The US State Department has notified Congress that it plans to close five foreign missions in a rare downsizing of America’s global diplomatic footprint, according to people familiar with the notice. In the notice sent to some congressional committees late last week, the State Department said it ‌planned to close its posts in St George’s, Grenada; Nagoya, Japan; Medan, Indonesia; Douala, Cameroon; and Winnipeg, Canada. The people familiar with the notice spoke on condition of anonymity because...
usa.titleZh: 消息人士称美国国务院将关闭驻加拿大、日本和印度尼西亚的领事馆
usa.summaryZh: 据知情人士透露，美国国务院已通知国会计划关闭五个海外外交机构，包括驻日本名古屋和加拿大温尼伯的领事馆。这是美国罕见的一次全球外交足迹缩减。
usa.whyImportant: 外交机构的裁撤可能削减美国在相关地区的影响力，并引发外界对其全球战略收缩的猜测。

usa.title: From Trump to El-Sayed: US Arabs in Michigan centre Palestine in politics
usa.summary: Arab Americans in Michigan who withheld support for Kamala Harris in 2024 say they will not back pro-Israel candidates.
usa.titleZh: 从特朗普到埃尔-赛义德：密歇根州的美国阿拉伯人将巴勒斯坦问题置于政治中心
usa.summaryZh: 密歇根州的阿拉伯裔美国选民表示，由于不满现任政府的立场，他们将不会支持亲以色列的候选人。巴勒斯坦问题已成为该群体参与政治决策的核心考量。
usa.whyImportant: 阿拉伯裔选民的政治动向可能对美国关键摇摆州的选举结果产生重要影响。

usa.title: Trump claims ‘last chance’ for Iran to strike deal in latest warning
usa.summary: US President Donald Trump on Monday said Iran was facing its “last chance” to reach an agreement with Washington to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the five-month-long war. “This is a last chance for them to sign a good document,” Trump said at the Oval Office in the White House. “I want to give them every last chance before decapitation.” He also claimed that negotiations with Tehran are “going on right now” despite Tehran’s insistence that no direct talks were under way. “We are talking,...
usa.titleZh: 特朗普称伊朗面临达成协议的“最后机会”，发出最新警告
usa.summaryZh: 特朗普总统表示，伊朗正面临与华盛顿达成协议的“最后机会”，以重新开放霍尔木兹海峡并结束战争。尽管德黑兰否认，特朗普仍声称双方正在进行谈判。
usa.whyImportant: 特朗普的强硬言论加剧了美伊之间的紧张局势，增加了地区冲突升级的风险。

watch.title: Board of Peace says no Israeli withdrawal from Gaza before Hamas disarms
watch.summary: Netanyahu and board director Maldenov meet amid tensions over Gaza disarmament roadmap and recent Israeli attacks.
watch.titleZh: 和平委员会称在哈马斯解除武装前，以色列不会从加沙撤军
watch.summaryZh: 内塔尼亚胡与委员会主任姆拉德诺夫举行会谈，讨论加沙解除武装路线图。双方在以色列近期袭击事件引发的紧张局势下寻求共识。
watch.whyImportant: 加沙地区的解除武装进程是实现长期和平的关键，但目前各方立场仍存在巨大分歧。

watch.title: Can a tech titan ace a test to fix India’s crisis-hit education system?
watch.summary: India’s tech titan Nandan Nilekani faces an uphill battle overhauling the country’s education system amid exam scandals, student protests and rising youth unemployment. Nilekani, co-founder of technology behemoth Infosys, was appointed head of a national task force for exam reforms following widespread anger and controversies over alleged paper leaks involving the competitive exam for aspiring doctors, the National Eligibility Entrance Test. Analysts say the real test for a reformer best known...
watch.titleZh: 科技巨头能否通过考试改革来解决印度的教育危机？
watch.summaryZh: 印度科技巨头南丹·尼勒卡尼被任命为考试改革特别工作组负责人，以应对考试丑闻和学生抗议。他面临着解决教育系统腐败和青年失业问题的艰巨挑战。
watch.whyImportant: 印度教育系统的改革成败直接关系到该国未来的人才储备及社会稳定。

watch.title: South Korea tightens grip on high-risk ETFs as investor losses mount
watch.summary: South Korea’s financial authorities are weighing tighter curbs on high-risk leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) as part of broader efforts to stabilise the country’s notoriously volatile stock market, which has left many investors with heavy losses and mounting debt. The proposals could include giving regulators the power to reduce the leverage ratio of single-stock ETFs and raising the minimum investment requirement to discourage inexperienced retail investors from taking excessive risks,...
watch.titleZh: 韩国收紧对高风险ETF的监管，投资者损失不断增加
watch.summaryZh: 韩国金融当局正考虑对高风险杠杆ETF实施更严格的限制，以稳定波动剧烈的股市。拟议措施包括降低杠杆率及提高投资门槛，旨在保护缺乏经验的散户投资者。
watch.whyImportant: 加强金融监管反映了韩国政府在防范系统性金融风险与保护投资者利益之间的平衡努力。

items.title: US stocks near record high, oil falls as Trump claims Iran talks underway
items.summary: Benchmark S&P500 approaches all-time peak as Washington, Tehran offer conflicting accounts of status of talks.
items.titleZh: 美股接近历史高点，特朗普称伊朗谈判正在进行，油价下跌
items.summaryZh: 标普500指数接近历史峰值。与此同时，华盛顿与德黑兰就谈判状态各执一词，市场对地缘政治局势的反应导致油价下跌。
items.whyImportant: 美伊关系的波动直接影响全球能源市场及金融市场的稳定性。

items.title: Can a tech titan ace a test to fix India’s crisis-hit education system?
items.summary: India’s tech titan Nandan Nilekani faces an uphill battle overhauling the country’s education system amid exam scandals, student protests and rising youth unemployment. Nilekani, co-founder of technology behemoth Infosys, was appointed head of a national task force for exam reforms following widespread anger and controversies over alleged paper leaks involving the competitive exam for aspiring doctors, the National Eligibility Entrance Test. Analysts say the real test for a reformer best known...
items.titleZh: 科技巨头能否通过考试改革来解决印度的教育危机？
items.summaryZh: 印度科技巨头南丹·尼勒卡尼被任命为考试改革特别工作组负责人，以应对考试丑闻和学生抗议。他面临着解决教育系统腐败和青年失业问题的艰巨挑战。
items.whyImportant: 印度教育系统的改革成败直接关系到该国未来的人才储备及社会稳定。

items.title: Russia says Ukrainian drone attack kills 7 at Black Sea resort beach
items.summary: Russia said on Monday that seven people, including three children, had been killed and 40 injured at its Black Sea holiday resort of Gelendzhik in what it said was a deliberate Ukrainian drone attack on civilians. There was no immediate comment from Ukraine, which like Russia, ‌says it does not deliberately target civilians in the full-scale war which Moscow launched in 2022. Social media videos, verified by Reuters, showed what appears to be a drone slamming into a busy beach area near the town...
items.titleZh: 俄罗斯称乌克兰无人机袭击导致黑海度假海滩7人死亡
items.summaryZh: 俄罗斯方面称，乌克兰无人机对黑海度假胜地格连吉克发动了蓄意袭击，造成包括三名儿童在内的7人死亡，另有40人受伤。乌克兰方面对此暂无回应，且此前一直否认在战争中蓄意针对平民。
items.whyImportant: 此次事件若属实，将标志着俄乌冲突中针对平民目标的袭击进一步升级，可能引发更严重的报复行动。

items.title: Trump declines to call for Max Miller’s resignation amid abuse allegations – as it happened
items.summary: This live blog is now closed. Sign up for the US Breaking News email On Tuesday, we’ll bring you the latest from Michigan where voters will head to the polls for competitive primaries in Senate and House races. The most closely watched competition is the Democratic primary for the US Senate, where congresswoman Haley Stevens is up against former public health official Abdul El-Sayed. They’re vying to ultimately win the seat of outgoing senator Gary Peters in November. The race has now turned into a proxy battle for the future of the Democratic party. Establishment-backed Stevens has received support from party leaders and her race has been buoyed by millions from the pro-Israel lobby. Meanwhile the insurgent El-Sayed has built a strong grassroots movement and is endorsed by progressives lawmakers in the Democratic caucus. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普拒绝在虐待指控中要求马克斯·米勒辞职
items.summaryZh: 美国密歇根州即将举行竞争激烈的初选，其中民主党参议院初选成为关注焦点。现任众议员海莉·史蒂文斯与前公共卫生官员阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德展开角逐，该选战被视为民主党未来走向的代理人战争。
items.whyImportant: 密歇根州的初选结果将反映民主党内部建制派与进步派之间的力量对比，对后续选举格局具有重要影响。

items.title: Japan’s prime minister tours earthquake-hit sites as recovery efforts hampered by soaring temperatures
items.summary: Prime minister Sanae Takaichi visited Kumamoto prefecture almost a week after a magnitude 7.1 quake hit, killing 38 people Japan’s prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, has visited the south-western prefecture of Kumamoto, where recovery efforts are being hampered by heat and a lack of water supplies, almost a week after a magnitude 7.1 earthquake killed dozens and caused widespread damage. Thirty-eight people died during the quake, including one person who died of apparent heatstroke while taking shelter in a car in hot weather, officials said on Monday. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 日本首相视察地震灾区，高温天气阻碍救援工作
items.summaryZh: 日本首相高市早苗视察了熊本县地震灾区，该地区一周前遭遇7.1级地震，已造成38人死亡。目前灾区面临高温和供水不足的严峻挑战，救援工作进展缓慢。
items.whyImportant: 极端天气叠加地震灾害对日本政府的应急响应能力提出了严峻考验，并引发了对灾民安置条件的关注。

items.title: Australia news live: St Kilda may lose hundreds of little penguins to bird flu; corruption inquiry told of $50,000 branch stacking scheme
items.summary: Follow today’s news live. Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Murray Watt, the federal environment minister, was asked earlier about former rugby league star Luke Bateman’s testimony before a parliamentary inquiry on gambling reform. Bateman alleged betting company promoters supplied him with cocaine and alcohol, also alleging he attended private Gold Coast events hosted by gambling firms where senior figures took illegal drugs with clients. We all feel for him and the circumstances that he went through. And for anyone to be offering illegal drugs as an inducement or for any other reason is obviously a crime. Should not be committed and people should pay a price if they’re engaging in that kind of criminal behavior. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻：圣基尔达小企鹅恐因禽流感大量死亡；腐败调查揭露5万美元“堆票”计划
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚联邦环境部长就前橄榄球明星卢克·贝特曼关于博彩公司提供非法药物的指控作出回应。此外，圣基尔达地区的小企鹅正面临禽流感的威胁。
items.whyImportant: 博彩行业的腐败指控和生态环境危机同时引发了澳大利亚公众对社会治理和环境保护的广泛讨论。

items.title: 北陸と東北が梅雨明け 気象庁発表 熱中症対策の徹底を
items.summary: 気象庁は、4日午前、北陸と東北南部、東北北部が「梅雨明けしたとみられる」と発表しました。すべての地域で梅雨明けしたことになりますが、福岡県では39度の危険な暑さが予想されているほか、熊本地震の被災地でも猛烈な暑さが予想されています。引き続き、熱中症への対策を徹底してください。
items.titleZh: 气象厅宣布北陆和东北地区梅雨结束，呼吁严防中暑
items.summaryZh: 日本气象厅宣布北陆、东北南部及北部地区梅雨季节结束。随着全国进入盛夏，多地预计将出现极端高温，政府呼吁民众务必采取防暑措施。
items.whyImportant: 梅雨结束标志着日本进入高温高湿的夏季，防暑降温成为公共卫生领域的首要任务。

items.title: 熊本地震の復旧へ予備費支出を決定 プッシュ型の物資支援など
items.summary: 政府は今回の熊本地震の復旧を迅速に進めるとして、今年度予算の予備費から242億円余りを支出することを決めました。
items.titleZh: 政府决定从预备费中支出资金用于熊本震后恢复
items.summaryZh: 为加快熊本震后恢复工作，日本政府决定从本年度预算预备费中拨出约242亿日元。资金将用于包括“推式”物资援助在内的紧急救灾措施。
items.whyImportant: 政府迅速拨付专项资金体现了对灾后重建工作的重视，旨在缓解灾区物资匮乏的燃眉之急。

items.title: “今回の熊本地震 特に暑さ対策が重要” 現地に派遣のDMAT医師
items.summary: 今回の熊本地震で、DMAT＝災害派遣医療チームとして今月2日まで熊本県に派遣された医師が、NHKの取材に応じました。被災地では断水が続き、連日、透析患者を別の病院に移送しているなどとしたうえで、10年前の熊本地震と比べて特に「暑さ」対策が重要だと訴えました。
items.titleZh: DMAT医生：此次熊本震后防暑降温尤为重要
items.summaryZh: 一名曾被派往熊本的灾害派遣医疗团队（DMAT）医生指出，灾区断水情况持续，且需不断转移透析患者。他强调，与十年前的地震相比，此次灾区的高温天气使得防暑工作成为重中之重。
items.whyImportant: 医疗专家的建议揭示了灾后特殊环境下公共卫生管理的复杂性，对后续救灾策略具有指导意义。

items.title: 熊本地震1週間 38人死亡 災害関連死いかに防ぐかが喫緊の課題
items.summary: 熊本県で最大震度7を観測した地震から4日で1週間です。これまでに災害関連死の疑いがある人などを含めて38人が死亡しました。被災地では連日、危険な暑さが続く中、車中泊を余儀なくされる人もいて、災害関連死をいかに防ぐかが喫緊の課題となっています。
items.titleZh: 熊本震后一周死亡人数达38人，如何预防灾害相关死亡成紧迫课题
items.summaryZh: 熊本县地震发生已满一周，包括疑似灾害相关死亡在内，遇难人数已达38人。在持续的高温天气下，许多灾民被迫在车内过夜，如何防止灾害相关死亡成为当前最紧迫的课题。
items.whyImportant: 灾害相关死亡的增加凸显了灾后安置环境对脆弱人群生命健康的直接威胁。

items.title: Sportsbet and Tabcorp deny allegations they sourced drugs and sex workers to encourage VIP clients to bet more
items.summary: Betting firms respond to claims made by anti-gambling campaigners Tim Costello and Luke Bateman at parliamentary inquiry Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Betting giants Sportsbet and Tabcorp say there is no evidence to substantiate allegations that account managers sourced drugs and sex workers to incentivise vulnerable people to bet more, calling for information about the claims to be provided to regulators. The anti-gambling campaigners Tim Costello and Luke Bateman used a parliamentary hearing into Labor’s legislation to curb gambling advertising to allege problem gamblers had been supplied with cocaine, alcohol and sex workers, alleging companies exercised no duty of care to their customers. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 博彩公司否认提供毒品和性工作者以诱导VIP客户投注
items.summaryZh: 针对反博彩活动人士的指控，博彩巨头Sportsbet和Tabcorp否认其客户经理曾提供毒品和性工作者来诱导赌徒。公司呼吁将相关证据提交给监管机构进行调查。
items.whyImportant: 此争议引发了对博彩行业道德标准及监管力度的广泛质疑，可能推动相关法律法规的收紧。

items.title: Immigrant being held at Delaney Hall dies, marking 22nd death in ICE custody
items.summary: Edwin Lopez-Cornejo, 41, was arrested in New Jersey in June, and died after a ‘medical emergency’, agency said An immigrant being held at a New Jersey ICE detention center died on 1 August, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) announced on Monday. Edwin Lopez-Cornejo, 41, is the 22nd person to die in ICE custody this year, according to agency data. Lopez-Cornejo, who is originally from El Salvador and first came to the US in 2006, was arrested by ICE agents in Plainfield, New Jersey, on 18 June and sent to Delaney Hall detention facility to await deportation. Less than two months later he suffered an unspecified “medical emergency”, and was later pronounced dead by University Hospital in Newark, New Jersey, ICE said. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 一名被拘留的移民在德莱尼大厅死亡，系今年ICE拘留期间第22起死亡事件
items.summaryZh: 美国国土安全部宣布，一名41岁的萨尔瓦多籍移民在被ICE拘留期间因“医疗紧急情况”死亡。这是今年以来在ICE拘留期间发生的第22起死亡事件。
items.whyImportant: 移民拘留中心的医疗保障和人权状况再次引发了美国国内关于移民政策的激烈辩论。

items.title: 防衛白書「新しい戦い方」に対応 防衛関係の産業基盤を強化
items.summary: ことしの防衛白書はAIやドローンを活用した「新しい戦い方」に対応するため、防衛関係の生産・技術基盤を強化する重要性を強調しています。また、中国については、軍事力の質と量を急速に強化しており、日本と国際社会の深刻な懸念事項だと指摘しています。
items.titleZh: 防卫白皮书：应对“新战法”，强化防卫产业基础
items.summaryZh: 日本今年的防卫白皮书强调，为应对人工智能和无人机带来的“新战法”，必须强化防卫生产和技术基础。白皮书同时指出，中国军力的快速增长是日本及国际社会的严重关切。
items.whyImportant: 日本防卫政策的调整反映了其对地区安全环境变化的担忧，并预示着未来防卫产业投入的增加。

items.title: Trump election claims debunked, US critical minerals fears: 7 US-China relations reads

items.titleZh: 特朗普选举主张被驳斥，美国对关键矿产的担忧：七篇关于美中关系的文章
items.summaryZh: 本文精选了近期关于美中关系的七篇重要报道，涵盖了美国对华关税政策及关键矿产供应链等议题。这些报道反映了当前美中在经贸与战略领域的复杂互动。
items.whyImportant: 梳理美中关系的关键议题有助于理解全球地缘政治与经济格局的演变趋势。

items.title: Chinese executive filmed taking cash on Colombia metro, South America’s biggest project
items.summary: Colombian prosecutors are investigating allegations that executives of a Chinese state-owned contractor building the Bogota metro demanded cash from a local subcontractor in exchange for releasing payments owed for work on the project, according to an investigation published over the weekend by Semana, the country’s leading news magazine. The consortium building the line has denied any wrongdoing, saying the money seen changing hands was a retention payment agreed upon between the two firms in a...
items.titleZh: 中国高管在哥伦比亚地铁项目现场被拍到收取现金
items.summaryZh: 哥伦比亚检察官正在调查中国国有承包商高管涉嫌向当地分包商索贿的指控。涉事财团否认存在不当行为，称相关款项为双方约定的保留金。
items.whyImportant: 此事件可能影响中国企业在海外大型基础设施项目中的声誉及后续合作环境。

items.title: 500 Hong Kong students get taste of military life as PLA summer camp returns
items.summary: About 500 Hong Kong students are getting a taste of army life, with the PLA garrison launching its annual summer camp to instil patriotism and discipline, and teach military skills, among young people. Among the new recruits is Lo Wan-lung, a Form One student at Salesian English School who is attending the two-week camp for the first time. Attracted by the chance of weapons-related training, the young military enthusiast said he was curious to experience holding weapons during mock shooting...
items.titleZh: 解放军夏令营回归，500名香港学生体验军旅生活
items.summaryZh: 约500名香港学生参加了为期两周的解放军夏令营，旨在培养爱国情怀、纪律意识并学习军事技能。学生们对模拟射击等训练表现出浓厚兴趣。
items.whyImportant: 此类活动旨在加强香港青少年对国家及军队的认知，是香港国民教育的重要组成部分。

items.title: KMT accuses Taiwan’s government of failing to uphold South China Sea claims
items.summary: Opposition parties in Taiwan have accused the government of failing to defend the island’s long-standing claims in the South China Sea, following its muted response to Philippine attempts to delimit a disputed shoal. “The government speaks loudly when confronting mainland China, but falls silent when Japan or the Philippines challenges Taiwan’s claims,” Kuomintang culture and communications committee director Chen I-hsin said on Sunday. Chen was referring to the Philippines’ move to assert...
items.titleZh: 国民党指责台湾当局未能捍卫南海主权主张
items.summaryZh: 台湾反对党指责民进党当局在南海问题上立场软弱，未能有效应对菲律宾对争议岛礁的划界企图。国民党批评当局在面对大陆时态度强硬，但在面对日菲挑战时却保持沉默。
items.whyImportant: 南海主权争议的复杂性持续影响台湾内部政治，并考验其在区域地缘政治中的外交策略。

items.title: Does the US blockade on Cuba make America safer?
items.summary: Trump just escalated restrictions on Havana warning that Cuba remains a ‘threat to national security’.
items.titleZh: 美国对古巴的封锁是否让美国更安全？
items.summaryZh: 特朗普升级了对哈瓦那的限制措施，警告称古巴仍是美国的“国家安全威胁”。这一政策引发了关于封锁措施有效性及必要性的讨论。
items.whyImportant: 美国对古巴的强硬政策反映了其在西半球的地缘战略考量，但其长期效果仍存争议。

items.title: US State Department to close consulates in Canada, Japan and Indonesia, sources say
items.summary: The US State Department has notified Congress that it plans to close five foreign missions in a rare downsizing of America’s global diplomatic footprint, according to people familiar with the notice. In the notice sent to some congressional committees late last week, the State Department said it ‌planned to close its posts in St George’s, Grenada; Nagoya, Japan; Medan, Indonesia; Douala, Cameroon; and Winnipeg, Canada. items.titleZh: 消息人士称美国国务院将关闭驻加拿大、日本和印度尼西亚的领事馆
items.summaryZh: 据知情人士透露，美国国务院已通知国会计划关闭五个海外外交机构，包括驻日本名古屋和加拿大温尼伯的领事馆。这是美国罕见的一次全球外交足迹缩减。
items.whyImportant: 外交机构的裁撤可能削减美国在相关地区的影响力，并引发外界对其全球战略收缩的猜测。

items.whyImportant: 阿拉伯裔选民的政治动向可能对美国关键摇摆州的选举结果产生重要影响。

items.titleZh: 特朗普称伊朗面临达成协议的“最后机会”，发出最新警告
items.summaryZh: 特朗普总统表示，伊朗正面临与华盛顿达成协议的“最后机会”，以重新开放霍尔木兹海峡并结束战争。尽管德黑兰否认，特朗普仍声称双方正在进行谈判。

items.title: South Korea tightens grip on high-risk ETFs as investor losses mount
items.summary: South Korea’s financial authorities are weighing tighter curbs on high-risk leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) as part of broader efforts to stabilise the country’s notoriously volatile stock market, which has left many investors with heavy losses and mounting debt. items.titleZh: 韩国收紧对高风险ETF的监管，投资者损失不断增加
items.summaryZh: 韩国金融当局正考虑对高风险杠杆ETF实施更严格的限制，以稳定波动剧烈的股市。拟议措施包括降低杠杆率及提高投资门槛，旨在保护缺乏经验的散户投资者。
items.whyImportant: 加强金融监管反映了韩国政府在防范系统性金融风险与保护投资者利益之间的平衡努力。
